reason: I don't try anything new until my sister-in-law or someone in my Zalo group already uses it. I have 5-10 techs and a system that works, so I'm not going to be the first guinea pig on something I saw once.
objection: Card fees are where the real money is. You say Stripe's rate with no markup, but is it really cheaper than what I pay now? And who else in our community is running this in their salon?
would_change_my_mind: My sister-in-law or another salon owner I know tells me they use it and their card fees went down.
